title: Harbourlight Relief International, Mozambique: the first 72 hours after a cyclone
summary: A fictional international NGO's Mozambique country office (WASH, health and shelter in Sofala and Zambezia provinces, a Beira warehouse) and an exercise generated from its simulated plans: the first 72 hours after a fictional cyclone hits the Beira coast, with cluster coordination, 3W reporting, a gap list, a customs hold, a cut road and a crowd-pressure security decision.
notice: EXERCISE MATERIAL — for training use. Harbourlight Relief International, its staff, sites, partners' contact people and the cyclone are simulated; Mozambique and the United Nations system are real; the public sources consulted for realism are listed in reference/cyclone-relief-ngo/SOURCES.md. No real victim, staff member or beneficiary is depicted.

scenarios.title: Wet Stock
scenarios.summary: A fictional Category 4 cyclone makes landfall near Beira late on Thursday; over the next 72 hours the NGO's country office must account for staff, stand up coordination with the Humanitarian Country Team and the clusters, report its 3W and close assigned gaps, handle a customs hold and a cut road to Buzi district, and keep its numbers consistent with headquarters, the cluster and OCHA.
